attributes.dossier:
# Dossier: Sample participant
## Aims
- [covered] Energy (E/I) (confidence: high) "quiet evening at home with a book or a side project. Big parties drain me"; skipped friend's birthday drinks for a game prototype, "mostly relieved". Both → I.
- [covered] Attention (S/N) (confidence: medium) "I jump to the big picture first... Details come later, sometimes too late." Also read a person and a story into an empty picture (thin: same line three times). Lean N.
- [partial] Deciding (T/F) (confidence: medium) Mixed. T-ish: weighted spreadsheet; partner said they ignored day-to-day feelings. F-ish: spreadsheet "partly to justify a gut feeling"; "if a choice hurts someone close to me, the numbers don't really matter"; guilt over the birthday. Chose to read the spreadsheet as a method, with values driving the real call. Lean F, mild.
- [partial] Living (J/P) (confidence: medium) Chose "Opened the editor and saw where it went" (1.6 s). Against: job spreadsheet (post-hoc by their own account). Lean P, mild-moderate, one source.
- [partial] Type + explanation (confidence: medium-low) INFP. The "does it feel right / what would you change" check was not asked because the participant chose to stop.
## Asked so far
- Opening: how's your day. "Mostly right. I think I'm warmer than that description makes me sound."
- Last free evening → quiet, book or side project
- Recent call affecting someone else → birthday drinks skipped
- What tipped it → job spreadsheet story
- What told the friend (twice) → canned reply
- Picture (react) → "Someone waiting for news. Tense but tender." ×3
- What made you see someone waiting → canned reply
- Prototype start → off-topic, then choice tool: dive in
- First thing noticed somewhere new → big picture, details later
- Offered stop or go on → "Let's stop here."
## What we know
- Sees themselves as warm (said)
- Quiet evenings; parties drain them (said)
- Skipped drinks, guilty but relieved (story)
- Spreadsheet justified a gut feeling; people over numbers (said)
- Dove into the editor (choice tool)
- Big picture first (said)
## Hypotheses to test
- P and F are each mild, one main source. A second story on deadlines or changed plans, and a forced logic-vs-feelings trade-off, would settle them.
## How to talk to them
- Terse, wry. Concrete "last time" prompts and narrow either/or tools work; abstract "what made you / what did you say" questions get a canned reply.
- Style now: warmth 4, humour 3, length 2 (short)
## Next moves
1. Ended at participant's request.
## Tools used
- picture (react): park bench at dusk. Repeated line; inferred a person and story (N, low).
- choice: prototype start → dive in (P, medium).
## Findings
- Energy: Time alone (I), high. A quiet evening and relief at skipping the party agree.
- Attention: Patterns and possibilities (N), medium. Own statement plus picture reading; would settle with a story of explaining something.
- Deciding: People and values (F), mild, medium-low. Pulls both ways; would settle with a forced trade-off.
- Living: Open and flexible (P), mild-moderate, medium. One choice; would settle with a deadline story.
- Type: INFP. The "does it feel right, what would you change" check was not done.

attributes.result: {"label":"The Warm Dreamer (INFP)","text":"You recharge alone: a quiet evening with a book or side project, and relief when you skipped the birthday drinks for your prototype. You reach for the big picture first, 'what could this become', and let the details catch up later. When a choice touches someone close, you say the numbers stop mattering, even if you build a spreadsheet to back up the gut feeling, and you dive into projects to see where they go. The solitude and big-picture sides are fairly solid. The people-over-logic and open-over-planned sides are milder and rest mostly on one story each, so they're the ones to question. I didn't get to ask whether the type feels right to you, so consider that your call."}
